metadata.quantum_depth_rationale: The task performs active-space electronic-structure reduction with reduced integrals, electron counts, and inactive-energy shifts.

task.problem_statement: Qiskit Nature can already load molecular electronic-structure data into a QMolecule, but users still lack a reusable active-space reduction utility that trims a molecule down to a chosen subset of orbitals and electrons before downstream algorithm steps. Users should be able to configure an active-space transformer, apply it to QMolecule instances loaded from HDF5 data, and obtain reduced integrals together with the correct electron counts and accumulated inactive-space energy shift.
requirements: Provide an ActiveSpaceTransformer abstraction for QMolecule-based active-space reduction workflows.
ActiveSpaceTransformer must accept the configured number of active electrons and orbitals, and optionally a separate number of active alpha electrons or an explicit list of active orbital indices.

ActiveSpaceTransformer.transform must reduce a QMolecule to the requested active space and return a new QMolecule containing the reduced molecular-orbital integrals and updated orbital and particle counts.
When the requested active space matches the full space, the returned QMolecule must preserve the original molecular-orbital integrals and record a zero ActiveSpaceTransformer energy shift.

When reducing to a smaller active space, the returned QMolecule must expose the expected reduced one- and two-electron integrals together with the correct inactive-space energy shift under the ActiveSpaceTransformer key.
ActiveSpaceTransformer must support QMolecule inputs that do not provide mo_occ by constructing the occupation information from the molecular electron counts.
Existing HDF5Driver loading and QMolecule save-load behavior for nearby molecular integral data must remain compatible.

interface.Name: ActiveSpaceTransformer
interface.Description: Represents a configurable active-space reduction over QMolecule instances.

interface.Name: ActiveSpaceTransformer.transform
interface.Description: Returns a reduced QMolecule whose active-space integrals, particle counts, orbital counts, and ActiveSpaceTransformer energy shift match the configured reduction.
